subject: No charts, javascript errors on Linux/R 2.15.2/Shiny 0.2.4

messages.author: 9cdbfdfb2ce0e860
messages.subject: No charts, javascript errors on Linux/R 2.15.2/Shiny 0.2.4
parts:
Hello, 

Shiny: v0.2.4
R: v2.15.2 
OS: Linux, RHEL4

I'm trying to get shiny up and running on an older RHEL4 server.    I am using the example posted on the homepage (histogram of the faithful dataset), but no png plots are generated. Further, I find the following Javascript errors:

1. WebSocket is undefined in shiny.js, line 417
2. this.$socket.readystate is null or not an object in shiny.js line 527

R is compiled and running well on the machine, and I can export ggplot2 graphics to png -- with a caveat.   I must supply the type=c('cairo') argument to the png function.   My x11 libraries are quite ancient and won't plot with R according to the capabilities() function. However I was able to get pixman and cairo installed correctly (excluding the xrender lib), with built-in support in R (--with-cairo compile time flag).     I can't however get the Cairo package installed, as it complains about some free-type error.     Regardless, I am able to automate png plot export as long as I include the cairo type argument as I mentioned above.

I have modified the server.R code, such that I am passing in the type=c('cairo') argument as follows:


output$main_plot <- reactivePlot(function() { # function code },type=c('cairo'))


Any ideas on what's going wrong, and how this can be fixed?

Thanks in advance

messages.author: d34d025a513c07fc
messages.subject: Re: No charts, javascript errors on Linux/R 2.15.2/Shiny 0.2.4
parts:
With regard to the cairo issue, I would guess that it's defaulting to
using x11. You can check this by running:
getOption("bitmapType")

You should be able to change the default type by putting this in your server.r:
options(bitmapType="cairo")

The Cairo package is completely separate, so you shouldn't have to
worry about getting it installed.

I don't know about the Javascript errors, so I'll let someone else
chime in on that.

-Winston

messages.author: 9cdbfdfb2ce0e860
messages.subject: No charts, javascript errors on Linux/R 2.15.2/Shiny 0.2.4
parts:
I just read that MSIE 8 does not sopport websockets, and that is what i am using here at the office. That might explain some of the websocket errors in shiny.js

But if that is the case, why do the demo apps on the Rstudio page, as well as other examples hosted on glimmer.rstudio.com all work ok with MSIE 8?

Does glimmer.studio.com use a different version of shiny under the hood that supports MSIE 8?

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: No charts, javascript errors on Linux/R 2.15.2/Shiny 0.2.4
parts:
Yes, glimmer.rstudio.com uses Shiny Server which will be available in late January as a beta (more details). Shiny Server uses the SockJS library for NodeJS to simulate websockets over regular HTTP, so it works fine with MSIE8/9.

This technique isn't possible using the Shiny R package alone because there is no SockJS library available for R.

Thanks and sorry for the inconvenience.
